en: <Mary> The Insect Master
jp: 蟲学者『マリア』

en: <Spipha> The Dragon Hunter
jp: 竜の狩人『スピファル』

en: <Erystia> The Scholar of History
jp: 歴史を学ぶ『エリステア』

en: <Bethel> The White Hawk
jp: 白き鷹『ヴェセル』

en: - In the Palmia Castle -
jp: - パルミア城 一室 -

en: I've taken care of the demon of transformation. Here's the document of proof from the information broker.
it: Abbiamo abbattuto il demone della trasformazione. Ecco, questo è il certificato dell'informatore.
jp: 変容の悪魔を討伐してきたわ。はい、これ情報屋の証明書ね。

en: Everything seems in order. We appreciate your help. Please take your reward.
it: Tutto in ordine. Grazie per aver abbattuto il demone di Cyronia. Ora ritirate il compenso, una alla volta.
jp: 確かに。サイロニアでの悪魔討伐、お疲れ様でした。では順番に報酬を受け取ってください。

en: Thanks, Ery. Ehh, this reward isn't as good as the one for putting down the dragon.
it: Grazie, Ery! Ehi, ma è più di quello che ci hanno dato per il drago dell'altra volta.
jp: エリちゃんサンキュー。へぇ、この前のドラゴン討伐より報酬良いじゃない。

en: Don't call me that. By the way, what happened to Regulus? He was with you when you left.
it: Non chiamarmi così. A proposito, che fine ha fatto Regulus? Eravate partiti in tre.
jp: その呼び方はやめて。ところでエユルはどうしたのです？３人で行ったはずですが。

en: He told us he needed to search for someone at the request location. It might be a few more days before he makes it back.
it: Ha detto che si fermava là dove abbiamo combattuto, a cercare una persona. Prima che torni potrebbero volerci giorni.
jp: 彼なら討伐先でしばらく人探しをすると言っていた。戻ってくるまで数日かかるかもしれない。

en: I see. Ah, right... Let me give you this.
it: Capisco, va bene. Ah, a proposito... devo consegnarti questa.
jp: なるほど、わかりました。ああ、そういえば…。これを渡しておかなくては。

en: What is this?
jp: この手紙は？

en: It's a letter from a Zanan officer. He asked me to pass it along.
it: Viene da un ufficiale dell'esercito di Zanan. Mi ha chiesto di darla a te.
jp: ザナン軍の士官からです。あなたに渡してほしいと。

en: ...Him, huh.
jp: …奴か。

en: Do you have any more requests? Like, you know, dragon hunting. Or dragon hunting. Or even dragon hunting.
it: C'è qualche altro incarico, adesso? Tipo caccia ai draghi, o caccia ai draghi, o magari caccia ai draghi.
jp: 今は他に依頼出てる？ドラゴン狩りとか、ドラゴン狩りとか、ドラゴン狩りとか。

en: A large bug outbreak is fine too.
it: A me va bene anche un'invasione di insetti.
jp: 蟲が大量発生しているとかでも構わないわよ。

en: ...There are no new requests. Please focus on investigating Lost Ylva for now. If you make any new discoveries, I'll reward you appropriately.
it: ...Al momento non ci sono nuove cacce da assegnare. Vi chiedo di occuparvi dell'indagine su Irva Perduta. Se scoprite qualcosa di nuovo, il compenso sarà commisurato a quello che portate.
jp: …今のところ新たに依頼する討伐もありません。ロストイルヴァの調査をお願いします。何か新しい発見があれば、内容に応じて報酬を出しましょう。

en: - Erystia's Private Room -
jp: - エリステア私室 -

en: Phew... That's 23 demons that have been taken down now. I still need to write the reports too. There's still some sporadic activity from Chaos Spirits, but I don't think there'll be any problem with sending the adventurers to Lost Ylva.
it: Uff... Così i ventitré demoni comparsi qua e là, e le altre sciagure, sono sistemati. Devo scrivere un altro rapporto. Gli spiriti del caos continuano a muoversi qua e là, ma dirottare gli avventurieri sull'indagine di Irva Perduta non dovrebbe creare problemi.
jp: ふぅ…。これで各地に現れた２３体の悪魔とその他の災厄の処理は完了ね。また報告書を書いておかないと。まだ混沌の精霊は散発的に活動を続けているようだけれど、冒険者たちはロストイルヴァの調査に回して問題ないでしょう。

en: At least while all of this is going on, the countries can put aside their quarrels for a while... Come to think of it, the countries that haven't joined the new alliance have had even larger damages to their capitals and important facilities. Is it just a coincidence...? For some reason or the other, something feels... wrong about this.
it: Fra la ricostruzione che tiene tutti occupati e l'alleanza, per un po' anche i litigi fra i paesi... A proposito: più un paese era restio a entrare nell'alleanza, più la sua capitale e i suoi centri nevralgici hanno subito danni. Sarà un caso...? C'è qualcosa, qualcosa che... sa di premeditato.
jp: 復興に多忙なのと同盟の存在で、しばらくは国同士の諍いも…そういえば同盟に加わりそうになかった国ほど、首都や重要拠点の被害が大きいわ。これは偶然…？なにかしら、なにか…作為的なものを感じる。

en: Perhaps I'll take a look into exactly where each of these demons originated from. Demon of illusion, demon of destruction, demon of erosion... I think I can narrow down where each of these first appeared from the initial reports...
it: Forse farò indagare i punti in cui i demoni sono comparsi, e anche da che cosa siano nati. Il demone dell'illusione, il demone della distruzione, il demone dell'erosione: per questi tre i primi rapporti dovrebbero bastare a restringere parecchio il luogo di comparsa...
jp: 発生原因の特定も含め、悪魔の出現地点を調査させてみようかしら。幻影の悪魔、破壊の悪魔、浸食の悪魔。この３体は初期報告から出現地点をかなり絞り込めるはずよ…。

en: <Orphe> The Apostle of Chaos
jp: 混沌の使徒『オルフェ』

en: <Alfred> the Cangnan Wind of Lothria
jp: ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』

en: <Orphe> Prince of the Ruined Nation
jp: 亡国の王子『オルフェ』

en: Kuh, this number of servants of Chaos... With the Eternal Seal just ahead, it's very abnormal.
it: Ngh, quanti sono questi figli del caos... Proprio davanti al Sigillo Eterno, un imprevisto coi fiocchi.
jp: くっ、なんという数の混沌の眷属だ…。神の間を目前にして、とんだイレギュラーだな。

en: The God of Chaos has already begun to awaken. There's not enough time, so leave this place to me. With my body I can't enter the location of the Eternal Seal anyways. I'm trusting you, Orphe. I'm sure you can win.
it: Il dio del caos sta già per svegliarsi. Non c'è tempo: qui lascia fare a me e va' avanti. Questi li trattengo io. Tanto con questo corpo nel Sigillo Eterno non potrei entrare. Conto su di te, Orphe. So che tu ce la puoi fare.
jp: 混沌の神は既に目覚めかけている。時間がない、ここは俺に任せて先に行け。こいつらは俺が食い止める。どうせ俺のこの身体では、神の間に入ることができないからな。頼んだぞオルフェ。お前ならきっとやれると信じている。

en: Umgh...! What was that vision just now? Almost like... some sort of distant memory. It gets a little clearer every time... I can almost remember...
it: Ngh...!? Ma che cos'è questa visione che mi torna da un po'? È come... un ricordo lontano. Si fa più nitida a poco a poco... sto per ricordare qualcosa...
jp: っ…！？先ほどから何なのだ、このビジョンは。まるで…遠い記憶のようではないか。少しずつ鮮明になっていく…何か思い出せそうだ…。

en: Ahh...
jp: あ、あ、あ。

en: I can't waste my time with this... I must reach the Seal as soon as possible... That's right... I need to get there... And release him...
it: Non è il momento... di perdersi in queste cose... devo arrivare al Sigillo Eterno... il prima possibile... Già... arrivando al Sigillo Eterno sarò... liberato...
jp: こんなことをしている…場合ではない…一刻も早く…神の間へと到達しなければ…。そうだ…神の間へ行けば解放…される…。

en: We're leaving. Now. Come on.
jp: すぐに出発する…。準備をしろ。

en: Oh? Is something wrong?
it: Oh. Non si sente affatto bene, a quanto pare.
jp: おや。随分と具合が悪そうですね？

en: It has nothing to do with you... Where is the Puppeteer?
it: Non è affar tuo. ...Dov'è finita la burattinaia?
jp: お前には関係のないことだ。…人形使いはどこに行った。

en: This is much sooner than my original plan.
it: È parecchio in anticipo sul piano che avevamo previsto, però.
jp: 当初の計画よりかなり早いのですが。

en: Huh...?
jp: おい…？

en: I'll have you disappear now.
it: Sarà qui che la farò sparire.
jp: 貴方にはここで消えてもらいましょう。

en: This is the power capable of reaching Aion...?! You bastard, you're going to transport me outside the castle just like the Servants!
it: Questa è una forza che arriva fino agli Aion...!? Verme, vuoi trasferirmi fuori dal castello come hai fatto coi figli del caos!
jp: これはアイオンに通じる力…！？貴様、眷属にやったように私を城の外に転送する気か！

en: Ah, right. That's what I told you when we became friends. That was a lie, though. This is simply a combination of science and magic.
it: Ah, già. Quando mi sono unito a lei gliel'ho raccontata così. Era una bugia. Questa non è che scienza e magia fuse insieme.
jp: ああ、そういえば。貴方の仲間になる際、そんな設定で話しましたね。あれは嘘です。これは科学と魔法の融合に過ぎません。

en: Impossible... For mere mortals to have such technology...
it: Assurdo... un mortale con una tecnica simile...
jp: 馬鹿な…定命にこんな技術が…。

en: Human beings progress with every generation. We don't stay the same forever. That aside, you're wrong about this being just teleportation. I said I'd make you disappear.
it: Anche gli uomini, di generazione in generazione, progrediscono. Non restano per sempre quelli di una volta. E poi un'altra cosa: trasferirla fuori dal castello sarebbe stato troppo poco. Le ho detto che la farò sparire.
jp: 人間だって世代を重ね、進歩しているのです。いつまでも昔のままじゃありません。それともう一つ、城の外に転送するだなんて生ぬるい。消えてもらうと言ったはずですよ。

en: Interrupting the dimensional distortion sequence. Enjoy your life in the space between dimensions.
it: Sequenza di distorsione dimensionale, interruzione forzata. Sparisci nella fenditura fra le dimensioni.
jp: 次元歪曲シーケンス、強制中断。次元の狭間に消えろ。

en: No... The Seal...!
jp: 私は…神の間に…ッ！

en: Ugh...!
jp: うぐっ…！

en: Acting earlier than planned was the right thing to do... My body... Is past its limits. There's no way I can make it to the Seal...
it: Ho fatto bene ad anticipare il piano. Anche il mio corpo... pare che il tempo sia scaduto. Ormai arrivare al Sigillo Eterno è una speranza persa...
jp: やはり計画よりも早めて正解でした。私の身体も…時間切れのようですから。もはや神の間へ辿り着くのは絶望的か…。

en: <Liana> The Girl of Fancies
it: <Liana> la ragazza dei sogni a occhi aperti
jp: 妄想少女『リアナ』

en: <Larnneire> The Listener of the Wind
jp: 風を聴く者『ラーネイレ』

en: <Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale
jp: 異形の森の使者『ロミアス』

en: <Regulus> the altered
jp: 改造人間『エユル』

en: <Loyter> the crimson of Zanan
jp: ザナンの紅の英雄『ロイター』

en: <Bethel> The White Hawk
jp: 白き鷹『ヴェセル』

en: - Near the capital of Cyronia -
it: - I dintorni della capitale di Cyronia -
jp: - サイロニア首都郊外 -

en: The story I heard is that Bethel was sent to this town to subdue a demon a few days ago.
it: Dicono che giorni fa abbiano mandato qui Bethel, per abbattere il demone comparso in questa città.
jp: この街に現れた悪魔を討伐するために、先日ヴェセルが送り込まれたって話よ。

en: You're kidding me, right? We headed for Cyronia just after arriving in North Tyris. How are we supposed to catch this guy?
it: Ne sei proprio sicura? Appena arrivati a Tyris del Nord ed ecco che tocca Cyronia: quando lo raggiungeremo, quello lì?
jp: 間違いないんだろうな？ノースティリスに着くなり今度はサイロニアと来た、一体いつになったら奴に追いつけるんだ？

en: Hmm. You guys looking for the White Hawk? He should be...
it: Ehm. Voi state cercando il falco bianco? Se è per lui...
jp: ん。あんたたち、白き鷹を探しているのか？あいつなら…

en: !!! You... You know where Bethel is!? Uuuuu.... Bethel!!!!!!!!
it: !!! Bethel! Sai dov'è Bethel!!!? Betheeel, aaaaaaah!!!
jp: ！！！！ヴェセルを！ヴェセルの居場所を知ってるの！！！？ヴェセルっっああああああ！！！

en: W-what the hell?
jp: な、なんだ一体。

en: Sorry about that. Calm down, Liana!
it: Scusala, è fatta così. Su, calmati, Liana!
jp: ごめんなさい、こういう子なの。ほら、落ち着いてリアナ！

en: Uuu... Bethel...
jp: ううっヴェセルぅ…。

en: Uhh... The White Hawk left immediately after defeating a demon here with me and two others. He should be in Palmia getting his reward... well, no, this enemy had the ability to transform equipment. He might be looking for some new armor.
it: Allora... il falco bianco di Zanan, dopo che in tre, lui, la cacciatrice di draghi e io, abbiamo abbattuto il demone, è tornato subito indietro. A quest'ora sarà a Palmia a ritirare il compenso... no, aspetta: il nemico gli aveva trasformato l'equipaggiamento. Magari è andato a cercarsene un altro.
jp: えーっと…。ザナンの白き鷹なら、竜の狩人とオレとの３人で悪魔を討伐したあと、すぐ帰ったぞ。今頃はパルミアで報酬を…いや、敵の能力で装備を変容させられていたからな。代わりの装備を探しに行っているかもしれない。

en: W-we're too late...?!
it: S-siamo arrivati tardi di un soffio...!?
jp: ひ、一足遅かった…！？

en: It's not surprising. We're using a special means of transportation... You can make the entire trip in a day. It's only natural you'd miss each other.
it: Con quel mezzo di trasporto speciale, o come si chiama, si va e si torna in meno di un giorno. Che vi siate incrociati è normale.
jp: 特別に用意された移動手段？ってやつで１日もかからずに往復できちまうからな。入れ違いになるのも仕方ないさ。

en: Why are you still here then? You don't appear to be from Cyronia.
it: Però, se è così, tu perché sei ancora qui? A vederti non sembri di Cyronia.
jp: しかし、それならなぜお前はまだここにいる？見たところサイロニア出身にも見えないが。

en: I stayed behind to look for someone. Which reminds me, do you know the child in this picture? She's my little sister. It's possible that only her face might still look the same though.
it: Anch'io sto cercando una persona. Ah, giusto: la ragazza di questa fotografia non l'avete vista? È mia sorella. Può darsi che sia cambiata e che le sia rimasto poco più di un'aria di famiglia.
jp: オレもちょっと人を探しててさ。そうだ、この写真の子を知らないか？オレの妹なんだ。もしかすると姿が変わっていて、面影程度しか残ってないかもしれないが。

en: Hmm... Sorry, but I haven't seen her.
jp: そうね…ごめんなさい、ちょっとわからないわ。

en: Sounds like my special talent might be of some use. I don't ever forget someone's face. Even if she's changed, I'll recognize her if I see her. I swear it!
it: Pare che tocchi al mio talento, allora: lascia fare a me. Io non dimentico la faccia di chi ho visto una volta. Anche se è cambiata un poco la riconosco! E questa... posso dirtelo con certezza, non la conosco!
jp: どうやらあたしの特技の出番のようね、任せて。あたしは一度見た人の顔を忘れないの。少しくらい変容してても見分けられるんだから！これは…知らないと断言できるわね！

en: Great... I wonder where she could be though... Well, it's about time for me to go back.
it: Capisco... Ma dove sarà finita... Anch'io è ora che torni.
jp: そうか…どこ行っちまったんだろうなぁ…。俺もそろそろ帰るか。

en: Hold on. Let us join you. I don't know exactly how you've been getting around, but it's got to be fast, right?
it: Aspetta. Portaci con te. Non so che mezzo sia, ma è veloce, no?
jp: 待て。私たちも一緒に連れていってくれ。どんな移動手段か知らないが、とにかく速いのだろう？

en: Uhhh... I don't think that's a good idea. I don't think you guys are strong enough to withstand it. There'd be nothing of you left by the time we got there.
it: Ehm... i vostri corpi non reggerebbero. Meglio lasciar perdere. All'arrivo non ne resterebbe nemmeno la forma. Ve lo garantisco.
jp: ええっと…あんたたちの体じゃ耐えられないだろうな。やめておいた方がいい。到着する頃には原型すら残らない。絶対にだ。

en: ...Liana, let's take a boat to Palmia.
jp: …リアナ、船でパルミアに向かいましょう。

en: O-Of course.
jp: え、ええ。

en: (What the hell are they using to get around...?)
it: (Ma che razza di mezzo di trasporto sarà mai...)
jp: （一体どんな移動手段なんだ…）

en: - At the same time, at the bar in Vernis. -
it: Alla stessa ora - l'osteria di Vernis -
jp: 同刻 - ヴェルニースの酒場 -

en: Here we are once again, Bethel Rumford.
it: Bethel Rumford. Chi l'avrebbe detto che avrei parlato ancora con te, e proprio qui.
jp: ヴェセル・ランフォード。またここで、貴様と話すことになるとはな。

en: ...You called me here with that letter. What is it you want?
it: ...Sei tu che mi hai chiamato. Con tanto di lettera, per giunta. Che cosa vuoi?
jp: …呼んだのはお前だろう。わざわざ手紙まで使って。用件は何だ。

en: It was quite disappointing when I arrested you here in this bar. You looked like a hermit. And then rumors started going around that you ran off into the Heretical Forest. I thought maybe you'd finally succumbed to the drugs and let yourself go... It was disheartening, let me tell you. But now I hear you've recovered and started working as an adventurer. To be honest, that surprised me.
it: Quando ti presi in questa osteria, ridotto a un eremita, ne fui molto deluso. E poi il vento portò voce che ti eri buttato nella Foresta Eretica in fiamme. Pensare che il falco bianco fosse arrivato a non capire più niente, all'ultimo stadio della droga... mi faceva una pena insopportabile. E invece adesso ti sei ripreso al punto di accettare incarichi da mezzo mondo come avventuriero. Confesso che mi ha stupito.
jp: この酒場で世捨て人同然のお前を捕えた時はひどく失望したものだ。しかも風の噂によればあの後、燃え盛る異形の森に飛び込んだともいうじゃないか。あの白き鷹が、薬物の末期症状でとうとう前後不覚に陥ったのかと思うと…情けなくて堪らなかったぞ。それが今では冒険者として各国の依頼を受けるまでに回復していたとは。正直驚いた。

en: How could a coward like you become an adventurer? Did you find a new woman? ...Hmph, whatever. If you've recovered, that's all that matters. Why don't you come back to Zanan?
it: Che cosa ti è successo, a te che eri ridotto a uno straccio? Ti sei trovato una donna nuova? ...Bah, poco importa. Se ti sei rimesso in piedi, va bene così. Non hai intenzione di tornare a Zanan?
jp: あれだけ腑抜けていた貴様に何があった。新しい女でもできたのか？…ふん、まぁいい。立ち直ったのなら、それでいいんだ。ザナンに戻ってくる気はないのか？

en: ...Sorry, but I have no intentions of going back.
it: ...Mi spiace. Ti dico che non ho intenzione di tornare.
jp: …悪いが。戻る気はないと言っておこう。

en: ...It was a joke. You know that, right? Even if you were to come back to Zanan now, there's nothing for you there. Not even your belongings.
it: ...Scherzavo. Ovvio che scherzavo. Se anche te ne tornassi adesso con tutta calma, a Zanan un posto per te non c'è più. E nemmeno per la tua roba.
jp: …冗談だ。冗談に決まっているだろう？今頃のこのこと戻ったところで、もうザナンに貴様の居場所はない。貴様の私物もな。

en: That's my...!
jp: これは私の…！

en: That's right. The magic sword you left behind when you fled from Zanan. It's been a pain taking care of it all these years. It's about time you start maintaining it again.
it: Esatto. La spada magica che lasciasti il giorno in cui scappasti da Zanan. Me la sono tenuta per anni, ma mantenerla è una seccatura. Riprenditela, e assumitene la responsabilità.
jp: そうだ。ザナンを飛び出したあの日、貴様が置いていった魔剣だ。長年俺が預かっていたが手入れが面倒でな。責任をもって引き取ってもらおうか。

en: ...Are you sure?
jp: …いいのか？

en: Take it. I don't know why you decided to become an adventurer, but I'll be keeping track of your accomplishments. If I ever see you in the same shape as you were in after that Elean girl died, I'll kill you myself.
it: Riprendila. Non so per che cosa tu faccia l'avventuriero, ma dibattiti fin dove ti riesce, e fammelo vedere. E se un'altra volta ti facessi vedere ridotto a uno straccio come quando perdesti la ragazza degli Elea, allora sarò io a ucciderti.
jp: 引き取れ。貴様が何のために冒険者をしているのかは知らんが、それで足掻けるところまで足掻いてみせろ。もし今度、エレアの娘を失った時のように腑抜けた姿を見せたなら、その時は俺がお前を殺してやる。

en: <Melget> the informer
jp: 情報魔の『メルゼッタ』

en: Mysterious Agent
jp: 謎の工作員

en: Mysterious Agent
jp: 謎の工作員

en: <Norne> the guide
jp: ガイドの『ノルン』

en: - In the Verizzia Woodlands -
jp: - ヴェーリッシア 森林地帯 -

en: Damn. I expected it to be a pain in the ass to locate the demon in this forest, but with what's it's done to the place, this should be a joke. Let's get this over with and get out of here.
it: Uau. Pensavo che girare per il bosco a cercare il punto in cui è comparso il demone fosse un lavoraccio, ma se i segni degli alberi abbattuti arrivano fin qui è una passeggiata. Trovo il posto in fretta e me ne torno.
jp: わーお。森の中を歩き回って悪魔の出現地点探すなんて面倒な仕事だと思ったけど、木を薙ぎ倒した痕がここまで残ってるなら楽勝かな。さっさと突き止めて帰ろっと。

en: The cleared area ends right about here... And nothing. This must be the spot it appeared in.
it: Gli alberi buttati giù arrivano più o meno fin qui... oh, e là c'è qualcosa. Il punto di comparsa è questo, non c'è dubbio.
jp: 薙ぎ倒されてるのはこの辺りまで…あ、何かあるじゃない。ここが出現地点で間違いないね。

en: (These things... Are these the biological mana batteries that Eulderna has been testing? Looks a little different. Maybe a subspecies... Looks like they these devices might funnel energy into the machine at the center, but what is this?)
it: (Queste cose allineate per terra... sono gli organismi accumulatori di mana che Eulderna sta provando in questo periodo? La forma è un po' diversa: per nasconderli, o perché è una sottospecie... Sembra che, passando per i dispositivi magici tutt'intorno, mandino energia alla macchina al centro; ma questa che cos'è?)
jp: （この地面に並べられてるのは…エウダーナで現在試験運用中のマナ貯蓄生物？少し形状が違うのは隠蔽のためなのか亜種なのか…周囲の魔道具を介して、中央の機械にエネルギーを送るようになっているみたいだけど、これは？）

en: (Ah, I think I've seen this machine before... That's right! It's just like the blueprints one of the Yerles high command put up on the black market!)
it: (Ah, anche questa macchina mi pare di averla già vista... sì! È identica a quella disegnata nei progetti che un alto ufficiale di Yerles vendette sottobanco!)
jp: （あっ、この機械も見覚えがあるかも…そう！前に、イェルスの高官が横流しした設計図に書かれてたのとそっくりだ！）

en: (I'm going to guess that this device uses the science of the Yerles and the magic of the Eulderna to summon the demons... Putting aside fusing those two, who has the power to put these devices all over the place...)
it: (A vedere com'è messa, sono di sicuro questi apparecchi ad aver evocato il demone. Ma una forza capace di fondere la magia di Eulderna e la scienza di Yerles, e per giunta di piazzare tanti apparecchi in mezzo mondo...)
jp: （状況から見てこれらの装置が悪魔を召喚したに違いないけれど、エウダーナの魔法とイェルスの科学…両方の技術を融合させたうえ、各地にこれだけの装置を設置できる勢力なんて…）

en: (...! Someone's coming!)
jp: （…！誰か来る！）

en: Finally here. Let's get to work collecting everything. Even if this is the last one, we can't get careless and leave evidence. I doubt anyone would come out here anyways though.
it: Siamo arrivati, cominciate il recupero. Non è che, siccome questo è l'ultimo, vi rilassate e lasciate tracce. Anche se in un bosco così lontano dalla strada maestra non verrà nessuno.
jp: 着いたぞ、回収を始めろ。ここが最後だからって、気を抜いて痕跡を残したりするなよ。街道からここまで外れた森の中には、さすがに誰も来ないだろうがな。

en: Yeah yeah. Tch... Looks like this one was a beast. Even the monolith is broken. Already behind, and then this... We really need some help from the other collection groups.
it: Agli ordini. ...Tsk, il demone ha fatto un bel disastro. Il monolito è andato in pezzi. Siamo già in ritardo sui tempi e ci mancava questa... Avrebbero potuto darci qualche uomo delle altre squadre.
jp: はいよ。…ちっ、悪魔の奴派手に暴れたな。モノリスが砕けてやがる。予定より遅れているというのにまた面倒な…。他の処理班から人手を分けて欲しかったくらいだ。

en: (These guys... Ah! I get it. The only country where talented people, money, and technology all gather together. And they did increase their number of undercover operatives recently. Now it all makes sense...)
it: (Questi sono... ah, ecco! Ora tutto torna. Quel paese dove confluiscono da tutto il mondo denaro, uomini e tecnica...! E anche nella malavita i loro agenti erano aumentati, ultimamente. Ora che ci penso, anche quei progetti finirono proprio là...)
jp: （こいつらは…そっか！合点がいったよ。世界中から金や人、技術が集まるあの国…！最近は裏社会にもあそこの工作員が増えてきてたっけ。今思えば、例の設計図の横流し先も…）

en: (This might be a bit more dangerous than I want to stick my head into... I think it's about time I report to Ery about all this.)
it: (Forse ho ficcato il naso in un affare grosso come non mi capitava da un pezzo. Be', e adesso come glielo spiego a Erystia...)
jp: （これは久々にやばいヤマに首突っ込んだかも。さて、エリステアちゃんには何て説明したものやら…）

en: - At the same time, at an unknown location. -
Master Tezcatlipoca, one of them disappeared. What is going on?
it: Signor Tezcatlipoca, quello è uscito di scena. Che cosa facciamo?
jp: テスカトリポカ様、奴が脱落しましたよ。いかがなされます？

en: It's nothing to be concerned about. Suitable replacements already approach the Seal.
it: Ma no, non c'è da preoccuparsi. Altri che possono prenderne il posto si stanno avvicinando al Sigillo Eterno.
jp: なに、案ずることはない。代わりと成り得る者たちが神の間へと近づいてきている。

en: Understood. I'll continue as normal until then.
it: Va bene. Fino ad allora mi limiterò a osservare.
jp: わかりました。ではその時まで、私も様子見に徹しておきます。

en: (Yes.. Just a little more... Just a little more...)
it: (Ah, ancora un poco... ancora un poco e...)
jp: （ああ、もう少し…もう少しで…）

en: {Sophia} The Wise
jp: 《叡智のソピアー》

en: {Itzpalt} Of Element
jp: 《元素のイツパロトル》

en: <Norne> the guide
jp: ガイドの『ノルン』

en: <Halion> The Extremist
jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』

en: <Regulus> the altered
jp: 改造人間『エユル』

en: Innkeeper
jp: 宿屋の主人

en: - Sacred Library of Ylva -
jp: - イルヴァ神立図書館 -

en: All the mortals are aiming for the Seal... Even more than I expected, but even so, I'm still worried.
it: Sono tutti qui i mortali che puntano al Sigillo Eterno... Ne abbiamo radunati più del previsto, eppure resto in ansia.
jp: 神の間を目指している定命はこれで全てか…。予定より多く揃ったがまだ不安が残る。

en: Will one of them become the Decisive Factor in this battle, or... Will none of them accomplish anything, instead falling into darkness? Even with my Wisdom I cannot tell.
it: Chi di loro mostrerà la sua forza e diventerà il Fattore Decisivo, oppure... non dovrebbe accadere, ma potrebbero non bastare, tutti quanti, e sparire nel buio. Nemmeno questa mia sapienza riesce a dirlo.
jp: 果たしてどの者が力を示し決戦因子となるのか、それとも…あってはならないことですが、いずれも力及ばず闇に消えるのか。この叡智を持ってしても見当がつきませんね。

en: I will continue my observations.
it: Continuerò a osservarli anch'io da qui.
jp: 引き続き、こちらでも観察しておきます。

en: Yes, please do. It's irritating, but we must save our divine powers for the final battle. Orphe's failure must not be repeated.
it: Sì, te ne prego. È frustrante, ma dobbiamo mettere da parte il potere divino in vista dello scontro finale. Non possiamo ripetere l'errore che facemmo con Orphe.
jp: ああ、お願いするよ。歯がゆいけれど、我々は決戦に向けて神力を蓄えておかねばならない。オルフェの時の失敗を繰り返すわけにはいかないからね。

en: ...The time is quickly approaching. I ask of you, Fairy. Continue to guide the mortals.
it: ...L'ora incalza. Conto su di te, fata che scruta il destino e ne fa da guida.
jp: …刻は迫っている。頼むぞ、運命を見通し導く妖精よ。

en: Understood.
jp: 了解しました。

en: (Though I don't know that mortals can change fate so easily...)
it: (Be', se il destino si potesse cambiare così facilmente non lo si chiamerebbe destino...)
jp: （まぁ、運命はそう簡単に変わらないから運命っていうんですけどね…）

en: - At the same time, in a small village in Monferniberre. -
it: Alla stessa ora - un villaggio del regno di Monferniberre -
jp: 同刻 - モンフェルニベール国　村落 -

en: Here's the inn.
jp: 宿屋に着いたぞ。

en: ...Is there seriously only one room? Well whatever. I'll stay here. Now where did I put my wallet...?
it: ...Come, c'è una stanza sola? Vabbè, per stanotte dormo qui. Dunque, dove ho messo la borsa...
jp: …なんだ一部屋しかないのか。まぁいい、今日はここに泊まろう。ええと、財布はどこに入れたか…。

en: Hah... Nothing again today. Hey boss, let me rent a room for the night.
it: Uff... anche oggi niente. Capo, prendo una stanza.
jp: はぁ…今日も収穫なしか。おっちゃん、部屋借りるぜ。

en: Sure thing.
jp: あいよ。

en: Ah...
jp: あっ…。

en: No problem. Adventurers can stay anywhere. I guess I don't have a choice... I'll take a look around and see if there's a place to lie down.
it: Beati loro, gli avventurieri, che dormono gratis. ...Pazienza. Mi cercherò qui intorno un posto dove stendermi.
jp: いいよな、冒険者は無料で宿泊できて。…仕方がない。どこかその辺りで横になれる場所を探すとしよう。

en: <Halion> The Extremist
jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』

en: <Regulus> the altered
jp: 改造人間『エユル』

en: Inkeeper
jp: 宿屋の主人

en: <Renai> The Meshera
jp: 『メシェーラ・レナイ』

en: - In a small village in Monferniberre. -
it: - Un villaggio del regno di Monferniberre -
jp: - モンフェルニベール国　村落 -

en: U-uwaaaaaj!
jp: う、うわああああああ！

en: ...So noisy. Is some drunkard getting too excited?
it: ...Che baccano. Sarà qualche ubriaco che fa chiasso?
jp: …うるさいな。酔っ払いが騒いでいるのか？

en: There's some sort of monster I've never seen before! It might be some sort of military experiment! H-help me...!
it: C'è un mostro come non se ne sono mai visti! Sarà una cavia dell'esercito, aiuto...!
jp: 見たこともない怪物だ！軍の実験体かもしれない、助けてくれぇ…！

en: T-this is...
jp: こ、これは。

en: Good timing! Are you an adventurer? You have to do something... It's already taken two people!
it: Arrivi al momento giusto! Sei un avventuriero, no? Fa' qualcosa... se n'è già assorbiti due.
jp: いいところに来た！お前冒険者だろう？何とかしてくれ…すでに二人取り込まれている。

en: Ga... ahh...
jp: が…ああ…。

en: Renai...? Yes, that has to be Renai! Finally I've found you... I'm sorry I took so long to find you.
it: Renai...? Non c'è dubbio, è Renai!! Finalmente ti ho trovata... scusami, ho tardato tanto a venirti a prendere.
jp: レナイ…？間違いない、レナイだ！！ようやく見つけた…すまない、迎えに来るのが遅くなった。

en: Kill... me...
jp: 殺し…て…。

en: ...I don't want to hear words like that pass your lips.
it: ...Dalla tua bocca non avrei voluto sentire parole così.
jp: …お前の口からそんな言葉は聞きたくなかったよ。

en: Do you know this thing? ...I hate to ruin your reunion, but that's not a human any more.
it: La conosci? ...Mi spiace guastare la commozione, ma quella non è più un essere umano.
jp: 知り合いなのか？…感動の再会を邪魔するようで悪いが、あれはもう人間ではないぞ。

en: Ah... Ga... Kill... Kill me...
jp: あ…がっ…殺し…殺して…。

en: Yeah. I told myself that if I found her and she was suffering, unable to adapt to the changes, then I would take care of everything myself.
it: Hai ragione. Se l'avessi trovata a soffrire, incapace di adattarsi, avevo deciso che l'avrei seppellita con queste mani, senza esitare.
jp: そうだな。もし適合できずに苦しんでいるようなら、その時はこの手で確実に葬るつもりだった。

en: But I can't do it after all. This may just make you suffer more, but... It's okay. We'll be together from now on.
it: Ma alla fine non ne sono capace. Forse ti farò soffrire ancora... ma non temere. D'ora in poi staremo sempre insieme.
jp: だがやはりそんなことはできない。お前を苦しませることになるだろうが…大丈夫。これからはずっと一緒だ。

en: Huh...?
Come, Renai. Absorb me.
jp: さぁ、レナイ。オレを同化しろ。

en: Woah. Hey... Hold on just a minute. Even if you do that, she's not going to be saved you know?!
it: Ehi. Ehi... aspetta un momento. Anche se lo fai, quella lì non si salva mica!?
jp: おい。おい…ちょっと待て。そんなことをしても、そいつは救われないんじゃないか！？

en: Please... Don't interfere.
jp: 邪魔を…しないでくれ。

en: Hii...
jp: ひっ…。

en: - In the Cradle of Chaos -
jp: - 混沌の巨城 -

en: ...Reporting in, sir. More than 40% are injured after that last battle. From here on, we need to be very careful with our healing magic.
it: ...Rapporto. Nello scontro di poco fa i feriti hanno superato il quaranta per cento. Pensando anche al seguito, credo che la magia di cura vada risparmiata.
jp: …報告します。先ほどの戦闘で負傷率が４０％を超えました。今後のことも考えると、回復魔法も節約が必要かと。

en: I see, so our consumption was greater than we had assumed... This area looks like a decent place to stop and make some preparations.
it: Capisco, ci stiamo logorando più del previsto... Meglio fermarsi da queste parti e rimettere in ordine i ranghi.
jp: なるほど、想定よりも消耗が激しい…。この辺りで一度態勢を整えたほうがよさそうですね。

en: Are you certain that's wise? Considering our target's status is unknown, I think we should advance to the lowest level as quickly as possible.
it: È saggio? Finché non sappiamo in che stato sia l'obiettivo, non dovremmo scendere ai piani bassi e cercarlo il prima possibile?
jp: よろしいのですか？対象の状態がわからない以上、一刻も早く下層へ進み捜索を行うべきでは。

en: In order to reach our target safely, we need to be prepared. This ruin of Nefia is difficult to deal with... Haste will lead to our deaths. Besides... It matters little whether our target is dead or alive when we reach it.
it: Proprio per raggiungere l'obiettivo sani e salvi dobbiamo rimettere in ordine i ranghi. Questa Nefia non si prende per il verso facile... avanzare di fretta ci porta allo sterminio. E poi... è stato stabilito che se l'obiettivo sia vivo o morto non conta.
jp: 対象に無事接触するためにも、態勢を整えなくてはなりません。このネフィアは一筋縄ではいかない…焦って進めば全滅に繋がります。それに…対象の生死は重要でないとされています。

en: But... That might be true, but still!
jp: それは…確かにそうですが！

en: We will make our preparations here. Make sure you're worrying about the right person first.
it: Piantala lì. Chi credi che stia in pena più di tutti?
jp: その辺にしておけ。一番心配しているのは誰だと思っている。

en: Notify the rest of the members. Prepare the area. We make camp here.
it: Comunicate a tutti: si spiani questo piano. Piantiamo qui il campo.
jp: 各員に通達。このフロアの整地準備を。ここに陣地を張ります。

en: Guard duty will be as we originally planned. Make sure to warn any intruders before intercepting.
it: I turni di guardia restano quelli previsti. Se arriva un intruso, prima di aprire il fuoco dategli sempre l'avvertimento.
jp: 見張りの交代は当初予定通りで。侵入者が来た場合は迎撃前に必ず警告を行ってください。

en: Understood. Oy, you sacks of lard! Start setting up camp immediately!
it: Ricevuto. Ehi, voialtri, preparatevi! Si comincia subito!
jp: 了解しました。おい、お前たち用意しろ！すぐに取り掛かるぞ！

en: (Tch...! Please remain safe...)
jp: （っ…！どうかご無事でいてください…）

en: <Sevilis> The Fog of Derphy
jp: ダルフィの霧『セビリス』

en: <Saimore> The Crown Prince of Zanan
jp: ザナンの皇子『サイモア』

en: Are you alright? There's no need to force yourself if you can't make it.
it: Tutto bene? Non eri obbligato a seguirmi a ogni costo.
jp: 大丈夫か？無理に着いてこなくてもよかったのだぞ。

en: This little pilgrimage is nothing compared to a life on the run. I don't think this will absolve me of my sins, but I want to be of at least some use. When I hear of someone investigating the Meshera, I can't just stay silent.
it: Un pellegrinaggio come questo, in confronto alla vita da fuggiasco, non è niente. Non credo che serva a espiare, ma adesso voglio rendermi utile a qualcuno. E sentendo che si indaga sugli effetti del Meshera non potevo starmene zitto.
jp: この程度の行脚、逃亡生活に比べれば大したことはない。罪滅ぼしになるとは思っていないが、今は何か人の役に立ちたいのだ。メシェーラの影響調査と聞いたら黙っておくわけにもいかない。

en: It's heartening to hear you say that. It's nice that Yerles began investigating an improved Meshera at the behest of Palmia, but to be frank, it's not really their specialty.
it: Che tu ti sia offerto, Saimore, è certo un conforto. Yerles ci ha chiesto per il tramite di Palmia di indagare sugli effetti del Meshera migliorato, e va bene; ma a dire il vero, senza uno che se ne intenda, è roba che ci sfugge di mano.
jp: 確かにサイモアが名乗り出てくれたのは心強い。イェルスからパルミアを通じて改良型メシェーラの影響調査を要請されたのはいいが、正直なところ専門がいないと手に余る内容だったからな。

en: ...And now I see how Duke Sevilis' works. Thinking about it now, my older brother always had many hardships regarding foreign affairs as well. At the time I couldn't understand his struggles and only lashed out.
it: ...Vedendo da vicino come lavorate, duca Sevilis, ho capito una cosa. Ora mi rendo conto che anche mio fratello penava, nei rapporti con l'estero. All'epoca io non ne sapevo nulla e non facevo che oppormi.
jp: …こうしてセビリス公の働きを近くで見ていてわかった。今に思えば兄も対外活動で苦労をしていた。当時の私は、兄の苦労を知らず反発してばかりだったが。

en: Duke Sevilis, I want you know something... My brother Clyne is said to have died in a terrible accident. But the truth is... I killed him. At a cliff just like this one. He was looking over the edge, and with my hand I just...
it: Duca Sevilis, voglio che siate voi a saperlo. ...Di mio fratello, il principe Clyne, si dice che sia morto in un incidente. In realtà... l'ho ucciso io. Era una rupe proprio come questa. Mio fratello guardava lontano, e io, con queste mani, dalla rupe...
jp: セビリス公、貴方には知ってほしい。…私の兄、クライン皇子は一般には事故死したことになっている。だが実際は…私が殺害したのだ。ちょうど、このような崖だった。遠景を見やる兄を、私はこの手で、崖から…。

en: Haha, even the cold-hearted shadow of Derphy is at a loss for words when faced with someone who committed fratricide.
it: Ah ah, davanti a un fratricida perfino la nebbia di Derphy resta senza parole.
jp: はは、兄殺しにはさすがのダルフィの霧も言葉に詰まるようだ。

en: ...As he began to fall, my older brother's eyes opened with surprise. It's only because he hadn't even taken the first precaution that I was able to approach him from behind. By the time he realized what was happening, nothing could be done.
it: ...Nell'attimo in cui cadeva, mio fratello aveva gli occhi spalancati per lo stupore. Se ero riuscito ad arrivargli alle spalle, a lui che era pratico d'armi, è perché non mi teneva d'occhio affatto. Pensava, immagino, che tanto non sarei stato capace di nulla.
jp: …落ちていく瞬間の兄の目は驚きで見開かれていたよ。武芸を嗜む兄に私が背後まで接近できたのは、そもそも警戒すらされていなかったからだ。どうせ何もできやしない、とでも思われていたのだろう。

en: Even now I dream of that moment when I pushed my brother over the ledge. At the time I felt powerful in the thought that I had triumphed over my brother, but now I can only think of how foolish I was.
it: Ancora adesso sogno quell'attimo, l'attimo in cui lo spinsi giù. Allora mi pesava soprattutto il pensiero di aver vinto su di lui; oggi vedo che sciocchezza ho fatto.
jp: 私は今でもあの瞬間を、兄を突き落とした瞬間を夢に見る。当時はあの兄に勝利したという想いが強かったが、今にしてみればなんと愚かなことをしたのか。

en: ...This isn't the time or place for lament.
jp: …悔やんだところでどうにもなるまい。

en: (At last he's admitted it. But I must say, even I find it to be pitiable.  I wasn't aware that Saimore had been driven into such a corner by an inferiority complex, I only cared for my own appearances.)
it: (E questo è tutto quello che sono riuscito a tirar fuori. Che miseria, se penso a me. Non sospettavo neppure che Saimore fosse spinto tanto in fondo dal senso d'inferiorità: badavo solo agli occhi degli altri e facevo, di facciata, la parte del premuroso.)
jp: （ようやく絞り出した言葉がこれか。我ながら情けない話だ。私はサイモアがそこまで劣等感で追い詰められていたとは露とも知らず、ただ周りの目を気にして上辺だけ、気遣うように振る舞っていた）

en: (Oh, I certainly showed him some degree of compassion. But more than anything, inwardly, I looked at my useless brother with contempt. And Saimore was able to sense that...
it: (Un po' di compassione l'avevo davvero. Ma più ancora, dentro di me, prendevo in giro quel fratello minore buono a nulla. E Saimore lo aveva sentito...)
jp: （同情の念も確かにあった。しかしそれ以上に、何もできない弟を内心小馬鹿にしていたのだ。そして、サイモアもそれを感じ取っていた…）

en: You're right. It's pointless to dwell on. It's not an act that can be forgiven just by confessing. The only man with the right to forgive me is no longer in this world...
it: Avete ragione voi. Non c'è rimedio. Confessarsi non basta a essere perdonati. E l'unico che avrebbe il diritto di perdonarmi non è più a questo mondo...
jp: 貴方の言う通りだ。どうにもならない。懺悔したところで許されるものでもない。唯一許す権利を持つ相手も、もうこの世にはいない…。

en: Let me say this, Saimore. You're not the only person in the world that regrets his past. Don't forget that. If you let the past hang over you, it will crush you some day. You need to continue moving forward. That is my only request.
it: Saimore. Una cosa te la dico. Non sei l'unico al mondo a rimpiangere il proprio passato. Non dimenticarlo. Portatelo addosso senza lasciarti schiacciare, e continua a camminare avanti: è quello che mi auguro.
jp: サイモア。これだけは言っておく。過去を悔やんでいる人間はお前だけではない。それを忘れるな。過去を背負いながら、それに押しつぶされず、どうか前に歩き続けて欲しい。私はそう願っている。

en: ...You're kind, Duke Sevilis.
jp: …セビリス公は優しいな。

en: {Sophia} The Wise
jp: 《叡智のソピアー》

en: <Bethel> The White Hawk
jp: 白き鷹『ヴェセル』

en: <Norne> The Guide
jp: ガイドの『ノルン』

en: - In the Sacred Library of Ylva -
jp: - イルヴァ神立図書館 -

en: So you've come. I've been expecting you. You are the closest mortal to the Eternal Seal, after all.
it: Hai fatto bene a venire. Conto su di te: al momento sei il mortale più vicino al Sigillo Eterno.
jp: よく来たね。君には期待しているよ。君は現時点で最も神の間に近い定命だからね。

en: I've only been descending without fighting. When it comes to combat, there are many stronger than I.
it: Io scendo scansando gli scontri veri, quasi scappando. Quanto a forza in battaglia, c'è chi vale più di me.
jp: 私は、まともに交戦せず逃げるようにして降りているだけだ。戦闘力だけなら私より上の者もいる。

en: Hmm... But your power is enough for you to become the Decisive Factor.
it: Uhm... Su quel punto, prima o poi, dovrai mostrare una forza degna del Fattore Decisivo.
jp: ふむ…。その点についてはいずれ、決戦因子に足る力を示してもらうことになるだろうね。

en: A moment ago, you said that I was the "closest mortal" to the Eternal Seal... But there are many humans, monsters, and machines within the Cradle of Chaos. Haven't many of them already passed the floor I have?
it: Poco fa hai detto che sono il mortale più vicino al Sigillo Eterno... ma dentro la Culla del Caos si accalcano uomini, mostri e macchine a frotte. Anche ai piani dove non sono ancora arrivato ci saranno molti mortali, no?
jp: 先ほど、「最も神の間に近い定命」と言ったが…巨城の中には大勢の人間や魔物、機械がひしめいていた。私の到達していない階層にも大勢の定命がいるのではないか？

en: Indeed, but as they cannot fulfill the role we require, I've excluded them. Those who have been defeated by a trial of Nefia were only summoned as a defense mechanism, you see. The Cradle of Chaos is connected to all the ruins of Nefia through the Mirage Tower.
it: Ah, quelli non possono diventare il Fattore Decisivo, e li ho esclusi. Sono soltanto chi perse un tempo la prova della Nefia, evocato lì come sistema di difesa. La Culla del Caos è collegata a tutte le Nefia attraverso la Torre Miraggio.
jp: ああ、それらは決戦因子に成り得ないから、除外しているよ。かつてネフィアの試練に敗れた者が防衛機能として召喚されているだけだからね。混沌の巨城は陽牢の塔を通じて全てのネフィアと繋がっているんだ。

en: Trial of Nefia...?
jp: ネフィアの試練…？

en: It is what you may know as Nefia Syndrome. It's a screening process, a way to finding mortals capable of maintaining a normal mental state even when being affected by the mind of a god. It was tough to come up with, let me tell you.
it: Quella che voi chiamate la sindrome di Nefia. Serve a scegliere i mortali portati: quelli che, anche investiti dal soffio di un dio, tengono la mente lucida e sanno combattere. Costruire il sistema è costato una fatica vera.
jp: 君たちが、ネフィア症候群と呼んでいるものだね。神の気にあてられても正常な思考を保って戦える、適性を持った定命を選別するのが目的だよ。システムの構築には本当に苦労した。

en: Wait. Nefia Syndrome is just a trial to select people...?! And those that fail are being used as a defense mechanism? What the hell is all this?
it: Ferma. La sindrome di Nefia sarebbe una prova di selezione...! E chi non è portato lo si usa per la difesa? Per che cosa ci prendi?
jp: 待て。ネフィア症候群が選別のための試練だと…！そして適性のない者を防衛に使う機能？我々を何だと思っているんだ。

en: Hmm...? Do you think this is bad? I think it's a perfectly effective way to make use of mortals with no other purpose. Besides, one can hardly expect diving into ruins of Nefia in the search of treasure to be safe. They brought it upon themselves.
it: Uhm...? C'era qualcosa di male? Mi pare un buon modo di far fruttare i mortali che non sono portati. E poi, sapendo benissimo che è pericoloso, nelle Nefia ci scendete lo stesso per i tesori. Direi che ognuno risponde di sé.
jp: ん…？何かいけなかったかな？適正の無い定命を有効活用する、いい手段だと思うのだけどね。それに、危険なことを承知の上でなお、財宝目当てでネフィアに潜っているはずだろう。自己責任だと思うがね。

en: Just how many people have been sacrificed since this "trial" began...? It doesn't matter. It's already far too many.
it: Da quando esistono le Nefia a oggi, quante vittime credi che ci siano state? Basta... ne ho abbastanza. Non pensavo che fra gli uomini e gli dei ci fosse un abisso simile nel dare valore alle cose.
jp: ネフィアの誕生から今まで、何人が犠牲になったと思っている。もういい…もうたくさんだ。こんなに人と神で価値観に差があるとは思わなかった。

en: ...So what the hell are you talking about when you say "Decisive Factor"? I understand it's someone that requires what is needed for the battle with the God of Chaos, but some specifics would be nice.
it: ...E allora, che cos'è mai questo Fattore Decisivo che vale tutto questo? Che serva per lo scontro finale col dio del caos l'ho capito. Ma in concreto, che cosa dovrebbe fare?
jp: …それで、ここまでして必要な決戦因子とは一体何だ。混沌の神との決戦に必要な人材なのは分かる。具体的には何をどうするというんだ。

en: It's not something that only the talented may hear, but... For now I cannot speak of it. Sorry about that. Once you've met the requirements I'll tell you.
it: Non è detto che debba essere una persona... ma su questo non posso ancora parlare. Mi dispiace. Te lo dirò quando ne avrai i requisiti.
jp: 別に人材に限った話ではないのだけど…それについては、まだ話すわけにはいかない。すまないね。君が資格を得た時に教えよう。

en: (Is that all I'm going to get out of her? The search of the Cradle is already suspended. I'll do as requested, but first I need to gather information.)
it: (Di più non riuscirò a cavarle. L'esplorazione del castello si ferma per ora. Invece di scendere come mi dicono, prima raccolgo informazioni.)
jp: （これ以上は聞き出せそうにないか。城の探索は一時中止だ。言われるがままに降りるより、先に情報を集めるとしよう）

en: That's not good, Lady Sophia. He completely mistrusted you.
it: Così non va, signora Sophia. Vi ha preso in totale diffidenza.
jp: 駄目ですよソピアー様。完全に不信感を抱かれていましたよ。

en: It matters not. Everything I said was true.
jp: 仕方がないよ。本当のことだからね。

en: Come on, given the circumstances, I think a few lies would be excusable. You should have lied to him to get him motivated.
it: Ma dai, non si dice che a fin di bene una bugia si può? Dovevate mentirgli, pur di dargli voglia di fare.
jp: ほら、嘘も方便というではありませんか。嘘をついてでもやる気を出させるべきでしたよ。

en: That would be deceiving him. I can't do such a disgraceful thing.
it: Sarebbe ingannarlo. Una scorrettezza simile non la so fare.
jp: それは騙すってことだよ。そんな不誠実なことはできないね。

en: (How easygoing he is! I knew I wouldn't be able to count on him. THAT person is the only one I can rely on.)
it: (Che leggerezza! Lo sapevo che non c'era da contarci. Su chi posso appoggiarmi, se non su quella persona...)
jp: （なんて呑気な！やっぱりアテにならないか。頼りになるのはあの方しかいない…）

en: <Kuroya> One Who Desires The Universe
jp: 宇宙を望む『クロヤ』

en: - In the Cradle of Chaos -
jp: - 混沌の巨城 -

en: Stop! This floor is now under our occupation. Leave now or regret it.
jp: 止まれ！このフロアは現在我々が占拠している。立ち去らなければ痛い目を見てもらう。

en: H-hey, be calm, I'm not going to do anything. By the looks of it, you guys are Elea... Nah, that one over there is from Zanan. A mixed force of Elea and Zanan, then... Wonder if that was part of the plan...
jp: おおっと、まいったねぇ。見たところ君たちはエレアか…いや、そっちにいる彼はザナンだな。エレアとザナンの混成部隊…それもここまでの規模となると…。

en: I heard about Lothria's special forces from an info broker, but you guys sure aren't what I was expecting.
jp: 情報魔からロスリアの特殊部隊がうろついていると聞いていたけれど、どうやら君たちのことで間違いないようだ。

en: So our info has already leaked to information brokers. We need to hurry then.
jp: 私たちの行動が一部の情報屋に漏れていたとは。これは急がなければならないようですね。

en: What's the rush? Just what you people from Lothria hope to do in this ruin of Nefia is beyond an old man like me.
jp: 急ぐというと進軍をかな？ロスリアが一体このネフィアに何をしに来ているのか、おじさん気になっちゃうな。

en: Be quiet, outsider! Your only option is to leave!
jp: 黙れ、部外者め！お前にできるのは大人しく立ち去ることだけよ。

en: I wonder about that? I'd say you lot are fairly exhausted as it is. I might not be a big-name adventurer, but if I went wild, I'd hazard a guess that I could do some serious damage, and certainly wear you all down even further. Shall we try it out, Mr. "We need to hurry"?
jp: それはどうかな？見たところそちらさんはかなり消耗しているみたいだ。僕も冒険者の端くれだからね、本気で暴れれば、消耗した君たちにそれなりの被害を出せると思うよ。いいのかなぁ、「急がなければならない」んだよね？

en: ...What do you want?
jp: …要求は何です？

en: Ah yes, I have one bit of business with you.
jp: そうだな、ここはひとつ取引と行こうじゃないか。

en: Business...?
jp: 取引ですって…？

en: That's right.
jp: そうさ。

en: Put your socks in this box. Your sex and age doesn't matter. Oh, but anyone who washed theirs doesn't need to bother. Give me your socks and I'll share with you the healing items that I bought too many of a little while ago.
jp: 老若男女問わない。この箱いっぱいに靴下を詰めてもらおうか。ああ、洗ったやつはいらないよ。靴下さえもらえれば、僕はこの先に進まないし、買いすぎた回復アイテムを君たちに分けてあげよう。

en: Socks? W-what are you, some type of pervert?!
jp: 靴下ぁ！？な、なんなんだこいつは！

en: ...Fine. We'll do as you ask. Make sure you keep your side of the bargain.
jp: …いいでしょう。すぐに用意させます。その代わり約束は守ってもらいますよ。

en: (What is with these adventurers...)
jp: （本当になんなの、この冒険者…）

en: <Liana> The Girl of Fancies
it: <Liana> la ragazza dei sogni a occhi aperti
jp: 妄想少女『リアナ』

en: <Larnneire> The Listener of the Wind
jp: 風を聴く者『ラーネイレ』

en: <Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale
jp: 異形の森の使者『ロミアス』

en: <Bethel> The White Hawk
jp: 白き鷹『ヴェセル』

en: - Near the sanctuary at the heart of Lost Ylva -
jp: - 中央神殿・周辺 -

en: We've made it. So this is Lost Ylva... The topography is different, but the plants and animals don't seem to be any different.
jp: 着いたわね。ここがロストイルヴァの地…。見渡した感じだと地形こそ独特だけど、生育している動植物は大して変わらないようね。

en: Lady Erystia said that Bethel should be in that castle you see there. We've finally caught up to him.
jp: パルミアでエリステア女史から聞いた通りなら、あそこに見える城にヴェセルが潜っているのね。ようやくここまで追いついた。

en: Maybe so, but it'd be foolish for us to enter. I hear even expert adventurers run out of there crying.
jp: まさかとは思うが、あの城に我々も行こうなどと言うんじゃないだろうな。熟練の冒険者も泣いて逃げ帰ってくるような場所と聞くが。

en: Let's wait at the sanctuary. It's close to the castle, and Bethel should return for supplies at some point.
jp: この神殿で待ちましょう。城から場所も近いしヴェセルだって補給に戻ってくるはずよ。

en: Tsk tsk tsk! So naive, Larnneire! The most basic rule of exploring ruins of Nefia is to make frequent trips back to the surface. There's not a single adventurer that would venture more than 10 floors without returning.
jp: ちっちっちっ、甘いわねラーネイレ！巨大ネフィア通いの基本は帰還よ。何十階もの階層をいちいち歩いて戻ってくる冒険者はそういないわ。

en: Is that so? I'm sorry. The only ruin of Nefia I've entered before is Remido.
jp: そういうものなの？ごめんなさい、ネフィアはレミード遺跡くらいしか入ったことがないものだから。

en: According to my information, the return point should be Ulm Lesson to the West. There are many stores and people that it as a base. Let's wait for him there.
jp: いい？情報によると、西にあるウールム・レゾンという遺跡が帰還ポイントになっているわ。店もあって拠点としている者も多い。そっちで待ちかまえましょう。

en: You've got to be kidding me. We're moving again? I'm already tired of walking.
jp: おいおい、また移動するのか？私はもう歩き疲れたのだが。

en: Lomias, Bethel helped us many times. If he's struggling all on his own, we should do our best to help him.
jp: ロミアス、私たちはヴェセルに何度も助けられたわ。もし彼が独りで困難に直面しているのであれば、力になってあげるべきよ。

en: That's right! And don't you want to see Bethel again?!
jp: そうよ！あんたヴェセルに会いたくないの！？

en: Nope. Not at all.
jp: いや、別に。

en: Come on, let's go. If we dilly dally, we might end up missing Bethel again.
jp: さぁ、出発しましょう。移動に時間をかけると、またヴェセルがどこかに行ってしまうかもしれないわ。

en: Bethel you bastard... I'm going to remember all this.
jp: くそ、ヴェセルめ…恨むぞ。

en: - Two hours later at the sanctuary -
jp: 二時間後 - 中央神殿・周辺 -

en: (I've found more details on Lost Ylva, but I still don't know what she meant by Decisive Factor.)
jp: （ロストイルヴァ中で聞き込みをしたが、決戦因子の詳細は分からないままか）

en: (But since the gods here won't talk, I think I'll make a trip back to Palmia. I'm worried about Liana. When I returned from defeating that demon last time, it seemed like she had gone out somewhere...
jp: （神々も口を割りそうにない、一度パルミアに戻るとしよう。リアナも心配しているはずだ。前回、悪魔討伐の折に戻った時はちょうど出かけていたようだったが…）

en: <Liana> The Girl of Fancies
it: <Liana> la ragazza dei sogni a occhi aperti
jp: 妄想少女『リアナ』

en: <Larnneire> The Listener of the Wind
jp: 風を聴く者『ラーネイレ』

en: <Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale
jp: 異形の森の使者『ロミアス』

en: <Leold> The Black Gauntlet
jp: 黒腕の『レオルド』

en: - At Ulm Lesson -
jp: - ウールム・レゾン -

en: W-we've finally made it... I don't think I can move anymore. I'm taking a break.
jp: よ、ようやく着いた…。もう足が動かない。私は休ませてもらうぞ。

en: Whew, we sure had to take a big detour to run away from that monster didn't we?
jp: いやぁ、魔物から逃げ回っていたら少し遠回りになっちゃったわね。

en: Lomias, please don't lie down in the middle of the street. It's disgraceful... I have to say though, this place is rather peaceful.
jp: ロミアス、そんなところに寝転がらないで。恥ずかしいじゃない。…それにしても思っていたより落ち着いた場所ね。

en: While there wasn't much, what little talk I heard of this place when we were on the surface made it seem really tense.
jp: 聞いた話だと下界との相互移動手段がなかった頃は、結構ピリピリした雰囲気だったらしいわよ。

en: Hmm. You three... Is this your first time here? You seem new to Lost Ylva. If you'd like, I can give you guidance on living in this land.
jp: む。お前達、この遺跡は初めてか？見たところロストイルヴァにも来たばかりのようだな。余計な世話でなければ、この土地での生活の知恵を授けるぞ。

en: Wonderful. Do you really think we can trust the advice of some weirdo we just met?
jp: 結構だ。初対面の怪しい輩のアドバイスなど信用できるか。

en: Cut it out, Lomias! ...I'm sorry, my companion is just irritated because he's tired.
jp: ちょっとロミアス！…ごめんなさい、連れは疲れて気が立っているんです。

en: You should focus on finding a bed and some food first. After that, if there's anything you need to know, please just ask me.
jp: とりあえず、寝床や食料は自分で確保する必要があることだけ言っておく。まぁ、俺はあっちにいるから後でわからないことがあったら聞いてくれ。

en: Your right arm... Would you happen to be <Leold> The Black Gauntlet?
jp: その右腕…ひょっとしてあなたが黒腕のレオルド？

en: Hoh. I wasn't aware I had become famous! Indeed, I am Leold.
jp: ほう。俺も有名になったものだな！いかにも俺がレオルドだ。

en: (Never heard of you.)
jp: （全然知らないわ）

en: But... I can't say I've ever heard of you?
jp: 全然知らないのだが？

en: ...I heard you're a trainer that can use experience gained from facing life-or-death struggled to awaken new powers within people.
jp: …死闘の中で得られた特別な経験を、新たな力として覚醒させる新手のトレーナーと聞いているわ。

en: Trainer... It's true my purpose is to create an exceptionally strong person, so you're not exactly wrong.
jp: トレーナー…。確かに強者に育て上げることが目的だから間違いではないが。

en: (These people... They don't carry the scent of strength. Maybe they've been in a few scuffles here and there, but they won't be able to utilize the jewel of awakening.)
jp: （こいつらは…特に強者の匂いがしないな。せいぜい修羅場を戦わずに数度切り抜けた程度か。覚醒の宝玉も活用できまい）

en: If you want to be strong, you need to be willing to put your life on the line. Later.
jp: もし強くなりたいのなら、死闘の中に身を置くことだ。じゃあな。

en: ...He left.
jp: …行ってしまったわ。

en: Larnneire. I'm going to sit at the top of the ruin so that I'll know immediately if Bethel comes.
jp: ラーネイレ。ヴェセルが来たらすぐわかるように、あたしは遺跡のてっぺんに陣取ることにするわね。

en: Hold on Liana, we'll go too. Come on Lomias, get up.
jp: 待ってリアナ、私も。ほらロミアス、行くわよ。

en: I don't have the willpower left to climb such a huge flight of stairs. I'm going to sleep.
jp: あんな長い階段を登る気力は無い。私は寝るぞ。

en: ...Suit yourself then.
jp: …もう勝手にして。

en: <Halion> The Extremist
jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』

en: <Carla> of The Forgotten World
jp: 忘れられた世界の『カルラ』

en: <Milos> of The Forgotten World
jp: 忘れられた世界の『ミロス』

en: Elean Refugee
jp: エレアの難民

en: - In Ruoza -
jp: 同刻 - ルオザ -

en: Oh, are you on a journey?
jp: あら、旅のお方ですか？

en: Larnneire! Why are you here?! ...Did you get separated? Where are the others?!
jp: ラーネイレ！？ラーネイレがなぜここに！…はぐれたのか？他の二人と！？

en: W-what are you are talking about? Hold on a second! I'm...
jp: な、なんですか？ちょっと待ってください！私は…。

en: Her name is Carla. Not Larnneire.
jp: 彼女はカルラだ。ラーネイレなどという名前ではない。

en: Hmm? ...Now that you mention it, while the face is similar, her hair and clothes are completely different. Sorry.
jp: なっ？…確かに、顔は似ているが髪の色や服装が全然違うな。すまない。

en: Milos! Thank goodness... You came to this world too, and we finally made it back together!
jp: ミロス！よかった…ようやく会えた！あなたもこの世界に来ていたのね。

en: Long time no see, Carla. It took me a long time to find you.
jp: 久しぶりだなカルラ。随分と探したぞ。

en: Mistaken identity... I really screwed up.
jp: 人違いか…恥をかいてしまった。

en: Huhhh? Wow, it's Halion. I haven't heard from you since the failed attack on Derphy. Glad to see you're safe!
jp: あれれ？ハリオンさんじゃないですか。ダルフィでロスリアの連中に襲われた時以来ですね。ご無事でしたか！

en: Mmm...? Ah, you were in the supply unit...! You survived! Our attack might have failed, but it was thanks to the supplies your unit gather that we were able to make it our safely.
jp: ん…？ああっ、お前は確か物資調達部隊の…！無事だったか！あの時は失敗にこそ終わったが、お前たちが充分な物資を集めてきてくれたおかげで、存分に活動できて助かったよ。

en: Hehe, I got really good at that kind of thing when I was a bandit. I really want to thank you for giving a job to those of us who were exiled from the Forest. I was really happy to be able to go wild and let loose. Now I'm barely scraping by from robbery and blackmail...
jp: へへ、物資強奪は野盗時代の日々で慣れてたんで。森から追放されたような俺たちも使ってくれて、ホント感謝してます。大義の元に思いきり暴れられて楽しかったですよ。今となっては通りすがりを恐喝するのが精いっぱいですがね…。

en: Ah.
jp: えっ。

en: Ah.
jp: えっ。

en: You were robbing... I thought we were collecting goods from supporters in the cities we passed, and collected things from the wilderness.
jp: 強奪ってお前…俺は各街にいる支援者からの物資受け取りや、野山での収集なんかを頼んでいただろう。

en: Hahaha, no way. Seriously? There's no way we would've collected enough materials like that. So we robbed towns under the guise of "procuring supplies", as well as any adventurers we encountered.
jp: いやいやいや、それ本気で言ってたんですか？その程度で手に入る物資なんてたかが知れてるじゃないですか。だからてっきり「調達」と称して街から強奪したり、野山で旅人を狩れって意味かと。

en: (N-No wonder our support was going down every day...!!)
jp: （ど、どうりで支援者が日に日に少なくなっていったわけだっ…！！）

en: I was busy, but I should have made sure everything was being done properly... No, hold on. Weren't you receiving specific instructions about your tasks?
jp: 俺も忙しかったとはいえちゃんと確認しておくべきだった…。いや、待てよ。毎回、どこの誰を訪ねてるようにと具体的な指示書を渡していたよな？

en: Huh? Sure, but ain't nobody got time to read all that. I didn't read them at least, and nobody else I know did either.
jp: あぁ？あんなに長い文章、当然読むわけないじゃないですか。少なくとも俺の周りの奴は誰も読んでませんでしたよ。

en: Incredible...
jp: なめてんのか貴様ら…。

en: <Melget> The Informer
jp: 情報魔の『メルゼッタ』

en: {Sinaha} of Misfortune
jp: 《不幸のシナア》

en: - At the Oasis in the Mirage Tower -
jp: - 陽牢の塔・オアシス -

en: Uehehehe... Good evening.
jp: うえっへっへっへ…ご機嫌うるわしゅう。

en: Ah. What do nyou want, mortal?
jp: あ？定命が何の用ニャ。

en: Well~, I just so happened to get my hands on something nice. I thought I'd bring it here as an offering to you.
jp: いやぁ～、面白い物を手に入れましてね。ぜひシナア様に奉納しようと思いましてぇ。

en: Nyaa~... Nyou have a good attitude. What have you brought me?
jp: ニャア～…いい心がけニャ。それで、何を持ってきたのかニャ。

en: Fufu, it's this.
jp: ふふ、こちらです。

en: ...? What's that, some sort of stick?
jp: …？何なのニャ、その棒切れは。

en: I-it can't be... It went extinct after the environmental changes in the last years of Rehm Ido!
jp: ま、まさか…それは環境の変化でレム・イド末期に絶滅した…！

en: Yes, it's  Silvervine. With the help of my various connections, we succeeded in restoring it.
jp: そう、マタタビです。色々なツテを頼って、復元に成功したんですよ。

en: O.. Ooo-~ Silvervine... How long it's been since I smelled nyou...
jp: お…おぉー♪マタタビ…最後に嗅いだのはいつだったかニャ…。

en: I thought you'd like it. There is plenty more in storage, so I can bring you more also.
jp: お気に召したようでなによりです。まだ倉庫にストックがありますので、もっと持ってくることもできますよ。

en: Wonderful, nyaa!! Maybe I should make nyou my servant... Now hurry, bring me more, nyaa.
jp: 素晴らしいニャ！！お前をアタシの下僕にしてやってもいいのニャ。…さぁ早く、それをよこしニャ。

en: Ahem...
jp: ふふん…。

en: Nyaa?
jp: ニャ？

en: Ahahaa... Nyow I see. What is your wish? Speak.
jp: ははぁーん…ニャるほど。望みは何だニャ？言ってみるがいいニャ。

en: I want special information that no other mortal knows. Though I don't expect you to tell me about the Eternal League, of course.
jp: 定命が知らないようなとっておきの情報を。もちろん、永遠の盟約で話せないことは結構です。

en: Hmm... In that case, did you know Ehekatl was originally a male god?
jp: ふぅん…それなら、最初のエヘカトルが男神だったことは知ってるかニャ？

en: ?! ...Give me more details.
jp: ！？…詳しくお聞かせください。

en: I guess it can't be helped, nyaa... It's fine to talk seriously sometimes.
jp: しょうがないニャア…たまには真面目に話すとしようか。

en: Let's see... Originally Ehekatl was the god of wind, and Itzpalt was the goddess of agriculture. But as a result of fighting and competition for domains during the War of the Gods, things have changed to how they are now.
jp: 例えば…最初のエヘカトルは風の男神、イツパロトルは農耕の女神だった。しかし、大戦中に他の神々と神徳を奪い合った結果、今のように司る物が変わったんだ。

en: (She just... skipped over everything?!)
jp: （語尾が…消えた！？）

en: I understand about their domains changing, but how did their sex change?
jp: 神徳が変化したのは分かりましたが、性別が変わっているのは？

en: After the War of the Gods, the name of the Gods has been unchanging, but there have been successors. The Gods are Gods, and are bound by oath... But those who want to be free to travel, who are tired of the work, or has fallen in love with a mortal... They have left for a variety of reasons.
jp: 大戦後、生き残った神々は襲名制で今日まで代替わりを続けてきた。神が神である以上は盟約に縛られるから…ある者は自由な旅に出るため、ある者は仕事が嫌になって、ある者は定命と恋に落ちて…様々な理由で辞めていったのさ。

en: The successors... The most capable avatar, mortals with outstanding capabilities, or even a hand-crafted vessel... They take over the name, and thus the power.
jp: それぞれの後継者…最も優秀な化身だったり、実力を認めた定命だったり、自作した器だったり…に力と名前を引き継いで、ね。

en: To be honest, we don't even know ourselves how many generations there have been. Or age. Ah, but I believe Itzpalt is only the second successor since the War of the Gods.
jp: アタシらも正直自分たちが何代目なのかはよく分かってないよ。年齢ももう適当さ。ああ、イツパロトルだけは大戦後からずっと二代目がやっているらしいけどね。

en: So, that's how their sex has changed. Ha....! I got to hear some good information. Well, a promise is a promise.
jp: それで性別まで異なる、と。はぁー…！いい情報が聞けました。では約束のブツを。

en: Silvervine!! Kuuu, I've wanted to smell you again for so so long~ Uhihi, I'm already getting silly, nyaa!
jp: マタタビィ！！くーっ、久しぶりのマタタビの香りは五臓六腑に染みわたるぅ♪うひひっ、早くも楽しくなってきたニャアッ！

en: (Let me get out of here before she gets too intoxicated.)
jp: （酔って絡まれないうちに退散しよっと）

en: <Norne> the guide
jp: ガイドの『ノルン』

en: <Barius> The Blue Haired
jp: 青い髪の『ヴァリウス』

en: personal guard
jp: 近衛兵

en: - At the same time, in Barius' private room. -
jp: 同刻 - ヴァリウスの私室 -

en: Hey there.
jp: やぁ。

en: Oh. I believe it's been a while since I've seen you, Norne.
jp: おや。久々に見たような気がしますよ、ノルン。

en: I'm very busy myself, you know. I'm not fooling around here.
jp: ボクだって忙しいんだよ。遊んでいるわけじゃないからね。

en: So, what do you have to report today then? ...Good news, I hope.
jp: それで、今日は何の報告でしょうか？…いい知らせだといいのですが。

en: Yeah, it's about the elite unit you sent over. They're no good. All of them are going to be wiped out, including the captain's daughter.
jp: ああ、君が送り込んだ精鋭部隊だけど。あれももう駄目だね。隊長の彼女含めてリタイアだよ。

en: What...? All of our country's elite? Even with their strength, they can't reach the Eternal Seal...
jp: なんと…我が国の精鋭たちが。あの戦力でも神の間には届かないというのか…。

en: My condolences. But of course, you'll be sending in more men, right?
jp: ご愁傷さま。もちろん、また追加で人員を送り込むんだろう？

en: No, there is no one close to the skill of Alfred and Lankata left...
jp: いえ、アルフレドやランカータほどの使い手はもう…。

en: *sigh* I guess it was an impossible plan after all. You wanted to take over Chaos yourself so that you could reign as the collective enemy of mankind. And yet, you couldn't even reach the status of godhood in the first place.
jp: はぁー。やっぱり無理があったみたいだね。混沌を乗っ取って、人類の共通の敵として君臨するっていう君の計画は。まず神のところまで辿り着けていないんだから。

en: ...Using a hypothetical "eventual crisis" like the Meshera was ineffective at uniting the people. Thus, I thought that if a "palpable threat" like the forces of Chaos continued to exist, then the rise of the Yutasu could be controlled. No matter. We will simply come up with another plan.
jp: …メシェーラのような「長期的な視点での危機」は効果がいまひとつでした。混沌の勢力のように「わかりやすい脅威」が存在し続ければ、ユタスも抑えられると思ったのですが。別の計画を考えるとしましょう。

en: Well, to be clear, you won't be getting any more help from me. The only reason I helped you with my visions of fate to begin with was solely because of the off chance that you might be the deciding factor. But if I don't get anything in return, well...
jp: 言っておくけど、ボクはもう協力しないよ。今まで運命視を使って状況把握に協力していたのは、君たちが決戦因子になるかもしれなかったからだ。見返りがないんじゃあ、ね。

en: Hmmm. I suppose it can't be helped.
jp: ふむ。仕方がありませんね。

en: Alrighty then, I'll be on my way. Good luck with your work.
jp: じゃあボクはこれで。せいぜい頑張ってよ。

en: You too. Gaius Vis was your homeland, right? I hope you'll be able to take it back.
jp: そちらこそ。ガイアス・ヴィスでしたか？故郷が奪還できるといいですね。

en: (Alfred, Lankata... I gave that father and daughter the toughest assignment imaginable. The fact they are only fated to not reach the seal means their deaths are not set in stone, which is a small relief.)
jp: （アルフレド、ランカータ…あの親子には想像以上に厳しい任務を与えてしまいました。到達の可能性がなくなったというだけで、死んだと決まったわけではないのが、まだ救いですね）

en: (Well... If we have no hope of maintaining a common enemy, we should at least join forces with the rest of the alliance to overcome it.)
jp: （さて…共通の敵を維持できないのであれば、せめて各国の力を合わせ乗り越える形にしなくては）

en: Excuse me. Your schedule for this afternoon, Master Barius...
jp: 失礼します。ヴァリウス様、午後のご予定ですが…。

en: Excellent timing. Prepare to send emissaries to all allied countries.
jp: ちょうどいいところに来ましたね。各国に使者を送る準備を。

en: <Melget> the informer
jp: 情報魔の『メルゼッタ』

en: {Sophia} The Wise
jp: 《叡智のソピアー》

en: - Sacred Library of Ylva -
jp: - イルヴァ神立図書館 -

en: You seem to have been learning a lot from the other gods. I've been monitoring your movements.
jp: 他の神から色々と聞き出しているようだね。君の動きはマークしていた。

en: That staff is very useful, isn't it? Hehehe... Well, if you know why I am here, then we can skip the formalities.
jp: その杖って便利ですよねぇ。へへへ…。というか分かっているなら話が早いです。

en: I suggest you go home. You have already learned all that a mortal can. It's a violation of the League to give any crucial information about the mission to any mortal who is not the Decisive Factor.
jp: 帰りなさい。君は、公開できることは一通り知ってしまった。決戦因子以外の定命に核心を教えるのは盟約に反するね。

en: I see. If it goes against the Eternal League of Nefia... Elona, then I suppose it can't be helped. But at this point, I already have a rough idea of the important parts.
jp: そうなんですか。ネフィアの永遠の盟約…Elonaに反するのなら仕方がありませんね。でも、その核心の部分。ほぼ見当がついてますよ。

en: ...That's not possible. I know everything that the gods have disclosed outside the Eternal Seal. You can't have any information that is close to the real truth.
jp: …ありえないね。私は神力の通じない神の間以外で起きたことは全て知ることができる。君は核心に迫る情報を持っていないはずだよ。

en: Long ago, after the majority of mankind left this planet for the stars, the story begins. In order to secure the faith of those that remained for themselves, the gods began a violent struggle. Over the course of the battle, thousands of gods perished and thousands of new gods were born. The balance of power changed rapidly. Truly, it was the Age of the God Wars.
jp: 昔々、人類の大半がこの星から旅立った後のお話です。自分への信仰心を確保するべく、神々は激しい争いを始めました。戦いの中で幾万もの神が滅び、幾千もの新しい神が生まれ、力関係も目まぐるしく変化しました。世はまさにゴッド戦国時代。

en: That much I've told you before. (...Age of the God Wars?)
jp: そこまでは前に話してあげたことだね。（ゴッド戦国時代？）

en: Behind the scenes, however, the God of Chaos was working in the shadows, orchestrating the conflict. The God of Chaos struck down the injured gods one by one, taking their power, and soon was strong enough to overwhelm the major gods. Realizing this, the gods stopped fighting each other, boarded their divine vessels, and fought a battle for the fate of the world.
jp: しかしその裏では、争いが起きるよう仕向けた混沌の神が暗躍していました。混沌の神は傷ついた神々を闇討ちして次々に取り込み、いつしか主神級を一蹴するほどの力をつけていたのです。それに気づいた神々は争いをやめ、神艦に乗り込んで天下分け目の合戦を挑みました。

en: It wasn't so much that the gods realized it, but rather Chaos declared war on them instead.
jp: 気づいたというか、向こうから宣戦布告してきたのだけどね。

en: And not even taking into account the demons they lead, the God of Chaos was already too powerful. The gods, who had no chance in a direct confrontation, decided to create a place that would cut off the god's divine power and forced them into it. It cost the lives of many gods, but they managed to seal the God of Chaos inside, and built the Cradle of Chaos on top of it. And rather than executing the 24 angels that turned to Chaos, they sealed them inside the Cradle as punishment.
jp: 取り巻きの精霊たちはともかく、混沌の神は強大でした。まともにぶつかっても勝ち目がなかった神々は、神力を断つ空間を作ってそこへ叩き込むことにしたのです。罠に嵌めるために大勢の神が道連れになりましたが、混沌の神をなんとか封じた神々は、その上に城を作りました。そして混沌へ寝返った全２４体の天使たちを滅さずに、罰として城に封印したのです。

en: There was a total of 72 angels who fell under the sway of Chaos. The 24 angels you're talking about were merely the ones who didn't perish in the ensuing conflict.
jp: 寝返った天使は全部で７２体だね。死んでいなかったのが２４体ってだけだよ。

en: The gods raised the continent to the heavens to monitor the Cradle of Chaos and isolate the areas that had been corrupted by the Great War. Thus, one continent was lost from Ylva. The power taken by the God of Chaos was gradually returned to the world via the towers, and in the process, the world was flooded with artifacts.
jp: 混沌の巨城の監視と、大戦でマナや気候が乱れた地域の隔離を目的に、神々は大陸を天に上げました。こうしてイルヴァからひとつの大陸が失われたのです。混沌の神から奪った力は塔を経由して少しずつ世界に還元され、その過程で世界にはアーティファクトが溢れるようになりました。

en: All that was left was to wait for them to weaken until the few gods that survived could defeat them... at least, that was the plan. However, the God of Chaos, who had amassed more power than anyone had expected, did not run out of their divine power even after tens of thousands of years. And their prison, the Eternal Seal, was weakening. If it were to fail, then the results would be disastrous. So it was decided they would build a new, stronger prison. Unfortunately, it became apparent the God of Chaos would awaken during the transfer.
jp: 後は、生き残ったわずかな神々でも倒せるようになるまで、弱るのを待つだけ…のはずでした。しかし、予想以上の力を蓄えていた混沌の神は数千、数万年経っても神力が尽きず、閉じ込めた空間…神の間のほうが老朽化で限界が来ていました。もしも機能不全を起こしたら大変なことになります。そこで、外側に一回り大きな神の間を新造することになりましたが、切替えをしている間は混沌の神が目覚めてしまうことが判明したのです。

en: They would need someone to keep the God of Chaos' attention during the transfer. But if a god, attempted to do so they risked being deprived of their divine power, where they would succumb either to the Eternal Seal or the God of Chaos themselves. After much deliberation, the strongest mortals of Naku Domara, the greatest civilization of the era, were chosen for the suicide squad.
jp: 切替え中に混沌の神の注意を引きつける者が必要になりましたが、神がそれをやろうとすると神の間か混沌の神かに神力を奪われて消滅する危険性があります。そうしたジレンマの末、ナーク・ドマーラ初期、当時の定命の最強戦力が決死隊に選ばれました。

en: A suicide squad isn't a nice way to describe them. One of them was rescued... yes. They were rescued, but...
jp: 決死隊とは人聞きが悪いね。一人はちゃんと助けられたよ。…うん。助けることはできたんだけどね…。

en: ...The gods, now keenly aware of the how they lacked the necessary power, sought to avoid a repeat of their failure. So they greatly increased the amount of divine power released into the world. Thus, magic appeared in the world, the Nefia were created, and the lives of the mortals were drastically changed. However, some grew addicted to this new power and started a war of magic. And so, Naku Domara was destroyed.
jp: …定命の力不足を痛感した神々は、もし次があった時がまずいと考え、世界への神力放出量を大幅に増やしました。世界に混沌と魔法の力がもたらされ、ネフィアが形成され、定命たちの生活は一変しました。しかし、力に溺れた者たちが魔法大戦を起こし、ナーク・ドマーラは滅んでしまったのです。

en: It was our fault. The situation was dire, but we should have gradually released the power to the mortals until they were able to discipline themselves in the use of it...
jp: あれは少し性急だった。結果論になってしまうけれど、力の使い方を自分たちで律することができるようになるまで少しずつ慣らしていくべきだったね…。

en: Some time later, a civilization with advanced biochemistry arose. The gods needed to perform another transfer, so once more they sought the aid of mortals. As a result, Messia, an artificial bacteria, came to be. It was capable of creating immensely powerful creatures at the cost of its host's body. However, the gods, who saw its power as a threat, allowed the Messia to run amok, thus bringing an end to Rehm-Ido.
jp: それからしばらくして生化学文明。また切替え作業が必要になった神々は戦力を募ります。その結果、メサイアと呼ばれる人工細菌によって最強の合成獣が作られ、その身と引き換えに役目を果たしました。しかし、その力を危険に思った神々はメサイアを暴走させ、レム・イドは滅びました。

en: That's not true! It was a complete accident that the Messia spiraled out of control! We had nothing to do with it. In fact, we were forced deal with the consequences for hundreds of years, so that the other sentient lifeforms were not wiped out!
jp: 違う！メサイアが暴走したのは完全な事故だ！私達は、関係ないどころか定命が全滅しないよう何百年も対応に追われたくらいだよ！

en: And now it is time for yet another transfer. What will be sacrificed this time? Not even the gods know.
jp: そして今回もまた切替えが必要な時期がやってきました。果たして今回はどのような犠牲が出るのでしょう？答えは神すらも知らず。

en: That's also wrong. The level of physical and technological advancement of the mortals have left them unrecognizable compared to those that came before. Theoretically, we should be able to defeat the God of Chaos this time. This will be the decisive battle, the one that finally breaks the cycle that has plagued us for millenia.
jp: それも違うね。放出量を見るに相当衰弱している。定命の身体能力・技術レベルも今や見違えるほどに向上した。理論上、今回で討伐できるはずだね。何代も続いてきた因縁を断つ、正真正銘の決戦だよ。

en: Hmmm. But are you sure you are fine with them being destroyed? The true identity of the God of Chaos is your ancestor, right?
jp: ふーん。…でも本当に討伐しちゃっていいんですか？混沌の神の正体ってあなたの親ですよね。

en: Ancestor? Mine?
jp: 親？？？私の？

en: It seems you have misunderstood something. They are... wait, what are you trying to make me say!?
jp: 何か勘違いしているようだね。あいつは私の…な、何を言わせる気！？

en: (Tch. Didn't fall for that last one, huh?)
jp: （チッ、最後は引っかからなかったか）

en: ...For someone who claimed to have a rough idea, your story seems to differ a lot from the actual events.
jp: …見当がついていると言った割には、さっきから結構違うようだね。

en: Oh really? And what might you be implying?
jp: アレレー？オカシイデスネー。

en: Enough. You should leave. The search for knowledge can put more than your own self in danger - it can have serious, wide-reaching consequences. Perhaps it's time you began to weigh the risks.
jp: もういいだろう。帰ってくれるね？知識欲と言うものは、自分の身を危険にさらすだけでは済まず、大変な事態を引き起こすこともあるんだ。そろそろ自重するべきだね。

en: (I think I've narrowed it down much more than I thought I would. Oh... but I forgot to mention that Orphe guy. Eh, I'll just try to siphon some information out of some other god.)
jp: （思っていたよりも絞り込めたなぁ。あ…オルフェって奴について確かめるの忘れてたわ。まぁいっか、どうせ他の神にもカマをかけに行くんだし）

en: Operation Chaos Spirit Eradicator? A joint effort by all member countries?
jp: 混沌の精霊殲滅作戦？各国合同で？

en: That's right. Everyone, please take a look at the documents before you.
jp: そうだ。皆、手元の資料を見てくれ。

en: "The spirits of Chaos, after they have consumed enough people and grown sufficiently, gather in one place to merge and multiply. It has been confirmed that more than 30,000 of them have already gathered in the Lothrian mountains." ...I thought that the number of attacks had been decreasing recently.
jp: 「人間を取り込んで充分に成長した混沌の精霊は、１箇所に集結し合体・増殖を行う。既にロスリアの山岳地帯に３万匹以上集まってきていることが確認されている」…最近、襲撃が減ってきていると思ったら、そんなことになっていたのですか。

en: Well... it's hard to wipe them all out when there are so many of them. And they're located right between the Lothrian capital and the port. We can't just drop gravity bombs on them. And even if we use conventional methods, it would be a catastrophe if the targets were to scatter all around the surrounding area.
jp: む…これだけ数がいると一網打尽は難しいな。しかもちょうどロスリアの首都と港の間だ。重力爆弾を落とすわけにもいかない。通常攻撃で炙り出すにしても、ターゲットが周囲に散ろうものなら大惨事だ。

en: Exactly. Look at Figure 2, the anticipated combat zone. Frankly, it's spread out too wide. Even with all our skilled adventurers and Yerleswood units, there's no way we can cover it all.
jp: そうだ。図２を見てくれ、予想される戦闘区域だ。正直言って広すぎる。腕利きの冒険者とイェルスード部隊をかきあつめても到底カバーできるものではない。

en: So, a joint operation made up of forces from each country. Sounds like a reasonable plan. If the intel provided by Lothria is true, that is. After all, there was the previous incident where everyone but the Yerles were deceived into attacking the 'Heretical Forest'.
jp: それで各国から戦力出しての合同作戦と。話の筋は通っていますね。ロスリアが挙げてきたこの観測データが本当なら、の話ですが。イェルス以外が騙されて異形の森を攻めた前事件もありますからね。

en: To be certain, Figure 3 was taken via satellite.
jp: 念のため、本国の衛星で撮影したのが図３だ。

en: What's with all these red dots... Wait. Those are their eyes glowing!
jp: 何だこの無数の赤い点々…うわっ。奴らの眼が光ってんのか、気持ち悪っ！

en: General, a word. According to the plan, are we to set up a frontline base near the capital of Lothria, and build a secondary base for transit in Melugas as well?
jp: 将軍、ちょっといいか。この計画では、ロスリアの首都近郊に前線基地を設けメルガストの転移拠点もそこに建設することになっているな。

en: Yes. Dimensional distortion navigation saves a significant amount of time and effort in transporting forces from different countries. And since it is possible to complete the entire trip in a day, we can easily gather a wide range of talented personnel.
jp: ああ。次元歪曲航法を使えば、各国から戦力を輸送する手間と時間が大幅に省ける。日帰りも可能だからな、優秀な人材も手軽に引っ張ってこれる。

en: But you're only building the core. While it's true that the core itself can be built on this schedule, you would need a massive energy supply as well in order to get it up and running. Do the people that came up with this plan understand that?
jp: だが、建設するのがコア部分だけになっているな。確かにコアだけならこの日程でも可能だが、大規模なエネルギー供給施設も造らないと稼働は不可能だぞ。この計画書を書いたやつはそこを理解しているのか？

en: That's what concerned me. I contacted alliance command... it seems that they are planning on using a mobile magic battery recently developed by Eulderna. It's called a mana monolith. It certainly seems to have the specs to get everything online.
jp: それが気になってな。参謀本部に問い合わせたよ。…なんでも、エウダーナで最近開発された移動式魔力電池を使うらしい。その名はマナモノリス。確かに稼働ラインまで持っていけるだけのスペックはあるようだ。

en: Eulderna were developing such a thing all along? But to integrate the technology of their former enemies... it must have left them quite conflicted.
jp: エウダーナはそんなものを開発していたのか。しかし敵国の技術と組み合わせることになるとは…向こうも複雑な気分だろうな。

en: (How did the architects of this plan come up with such a pairing? Did they somehow know about the existence and performance of both the dimensional distortion drive and the mana monoliths before this...?)
jp: （この計画の発案者はよくそんな組み合わせに至りましたね。次元歪曲航法とマナモノリス、両方の存在と性能について以前から知っていた…？）

en: (Ugh, I'm so sleepy. Hurry up and end the meeting...)
jp: （眠い…早く終わってくれ…）

en: {Sophia} The Wise
jp: 《叡智のソピアー》

en: Night Smoke <Tezcatlipoca>
jp: 夜煙の『テスカトリポカ』

en: <Orphe> Prince of the Ruined Nation
jp: 混沌の寵児『オルフェ』

en: - ????? Years Ago, Sacred Library of Ylva -
jp: ？？？？？年前- イルヴァ神立図書館 -

en: Orphe. I'm glad you made it out alive, at least. As for the others... well, I'm sorry.
jp: オルフェ、お前だけでも生還できてよかった。他の者は…残念だったが。

en: What happened to your... right arm?
jp: その…右腕は…どうしたんだ？

en: Oh, this? I was in the middle of holding off the forces of Chaos when I let my guard down and the serpent bit it off. I'm going to leave it as is, as a memento of sorts.
jp: これか。混沌の軍勢を食い止めている最中、油断してサーペントに食いちぎられてしまってな。戒めとしてそのままにしておくつもりだ。

en: By the way, I would like to know what condition the God of Chaos is in now. We have no way to confirm things ourselves.
jp: ところで今の混沌の神はどんな状態なのか教えてほしい。こちらは確認する方法がないからね。

en: Sorry... it's been a long day... and I'm tired. I'll tell you tomorrow.
jp: すまない…色々あって…疲れているんだ。明日に…してほしい。

en: Looks like you're having trouble with small talk. Considering the bloody battle and the loss of your friends, I'm not surprised.
jp: どうやら普通に喋るのもつらいようだな。死闘を繰り広げ仲間を失った後では無理もない。

en: ...You certainly look pale. The library may not have the best bedding, but I suggest you stay the night.
jp: …確かに顔色もずいぶんと悪いね。図書館ゆえに大した寝具もないが、今晩は泊まっていくといい。

en: As for me, I'll be heading home. But I'll be back in the morning.
jp: 我は一度帰る。明日の朝また来るぞ。

en: Is something... wrong...?
jp: 何か…用事でも…？

en: I'm just going to take the mirror my predecessor left behind and fashion a new arm out of it. You get some rest, Orphe.
jp: 初代の遺した鏡を加工して義手にしようと思ってな。ゆっくり休めよオルフェ。

en: (*grins*)
jp: （ニヤリ）

en: Tezcatlipoca, you're here! Have you seen Orphe? When I woke up, he were nowhere to be found.
jp: 来たかテスカトリポカ！オルフェを見ていないか？起きたらいなくなっていたんだ。

en: Huh? No, I have no idea where he would be. Wait, couldn't you look in the Origin of Vice for the answer?
jp: ？どういうことだ。待てよ、常闇の眼には何か記録が残っていないのか。

en: It only contains the records of the lower world. Moreover, even if it did hold such knowledge, it seems that Orphe took the Origin and its pedestal in the night...
jp: あれには下界の記録しか入らないからね。そもそも、夜の間にオルフェが常闇の眼を台座ごと持ち去ったようでね…。

en: Orphe, why...?
jp: オルフェ、なぜだ…。

en: Perhaps he had gone mad by the time he emerged from the Eternal Seal. Or maybe he was brainwashed in some way.
jp: もしかすると、神の間から出てきた時点でとち狂っていたか。もしくは何らかの方法で洗脳されていた可能性があるね。

en: What about Itzpalt?
jp: イツパロトルには？

en: I'll have to talk to him. If we don't find the Origin soon, then we will have to create a replacement ourselves.
jp: 話さなきゃいけないね。すぐ見つからなかった場合、混沌の眼の代替品も新造しなきゃいけないからね。

en: (When the Staff of Vice was finally completed and used to track down the Origin of Vice and Orphe, many years had passed.)
jp: （常闇の杖が完成し、その効力で常闇の眼とオルフェが発見された時、あれから長い年月が経っていた）

en: (He was no longer human. Perhaps he became an incarnation of Chaos through some form of contract.)
jp: （奴はもう人間ではない。おそらく契約など何らかの形で、混沌の神の力を得て化身となったのだろう）

en: (What was his goal? If all he wanted to do was destroy the Eternal Seal and release the God of Chaos, then he could have worked with the armies of Chaos. If anything, he could have simply given them the order and left the whole ordeal to them. There should have been no reason for him to reach the Eternal Seal on his own.)
jp: （奴の目的は一体何だったのか？老朽化した神の間を外から破壊し解放するだけならば、混沌の軍勢と共に行動すればいいはず。なんなら奴らに命じて丸投げしてもいい。混沌の軍勢に先だって、独自に神の間を目指す必要はないはずだ）

en: (Orphe released the demons because he encountered a mortal that had the ability to do so along the way. It's entirely possible this was a spur of the moment decision to distract us and stall for time.)
jp: （悪魔たちを解放して世界に撒いたのも、道中でその能力を持つ定命に出会ったからだ。最初から計画していたものではなく、ついで…あわよくば撹乱・足止めするためのオトリに過ぎなかった可能性がある）

en: (Little is known about what he did during the period between the disappearance of the Origin of Vice and the completion of the Staff. I let him continue with his schemes even after I had found him, but I was still no closer to discovering his true intentions. In the end, all that matters is that he was cast into the rift between dimensions by the mortal he sought to use...)
jp: （常闇の眼消失から杖完成までの期間に何をしていたのかもほとんどわかっていない。発見後も泳がせてみたがさっぱり意図が見えなかった。肝心の本人も定命の技術で次元の狭間へ落とされてしまったからな…）

en: ...At this point, there's no point in worrying about it anymore. We just have to vanquish the God of Chaos with the Decisive Factor. It's time to put an end to this!
jp: …悩んでもしょうがない。とにかく、決戦因子とともに混沌の神を打倒するだけだ。終止符を打つ時が来た…！
